🇫🇷 Groupe Bernard Database Allegedly Leaked — 22.25 GB / 330K+ Files  A cybercrime forum actor has published what they claim is data belonging to French agricultural company Groupe Bernard as part of the ongoing "BlgCloud" leak series.  * The release is labeled "BlgCloud Leak #13"  * Approximately 22.25 GB of data is claimed to have been exposed  * The archive allegedly contains 330,563 files  * The post includes what the actor describes as a CRM data sample  * Groupe Bernard is a French group operating across agriculture, grain and animal nutrition  * The same actor previously released data allegedly belonging to French equipment-rental company Dron as "BlgCloud Leak #12"  * The actor says additional organizations will be released and identifies French construction company CL-BTP as the intended target of Leak #14  ⚠️ Analyst Note:  The claim should remain classified as unverified until the exposed material can be independently validated against Groupe Bernard systems or acknowledged by the organization.  More importantly, this appears to be part of a sequential disclosure campaign rather than an isolated leak. The actor's advance identification of another alleged victim provides an opportunity for potentially affected organizations to investigate exposure before publication.  #DDW #France #GroupeBernard #BlgCloud #DarkWeb #DataBreach #ThreatIntelligence

🇮🇳 Alleged PhonePe Database Published on Cybercrime Forum  A threat actor has posted what they claim is a database associated with PhonePe, the Indian digital payments and financial services platform.  * The forum post explicitly identifies PhonePe.com as the alleged target  * The actor provides a third-party file-hosting link described as a database download  * A Telegram channel associated with the poster is also promoted alongside the alleged leak  * The post does not disclose the number of affected records, specific data fields, method of compromise, or date of the alleged intrusion  * No substantive sample data is visible in the post to independently establish that the database originated from PhonePe  ⚠️ Analyst Note:  At this stage, this should be treated strictly as an unverified cybercrime-forum claim, not confirmation that PhonePe has suffered a new data breach.  The lack of visible samples, record counts, timestamps and technical evidence significantly limits attribution and validation. Historical, aggregated, fabricated or third-party data can also be mislabeled as belonging directly to a well-known organization.  Further validation is required before characterizing this as a confirmed PhonePe security incident.  #DDW #India #PhonePe #DarkWeb #DataBreach #ThreatIntelligence #Cybersecurity

🚨 Researcher Discloses Five High-Risk Vulnerabilities in Palo Alto GlobalProtect  Security researcher Martijn van Ramesdonk has publicly detailed five security vulnerabilities he says he responsibly disclosed to Palo Alto Networks involving GlobalProtect — the VPN and endpoint software deployed across many enterprise environments.  The findings reportedly range from local privilege escalation to recovery of Active Directory credentials.  * Five vulnerabilities were reported to Palo Alto Networks in early April 2026  * Two findings were subsequently addressed under CVE-2026-0251  * The researcher says these issues were initially patched without notification or researcher credit  * Two additional vulnerabilities were reportedly classified by Palo Alto Networks as outside the scope of its disclosure program  * A fifth vulnerability remains undisclosed while the vendor works on remediation  Among the reported technical impacts:  * Local privilege escalation to NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM  * Recovery of a user's Active Directory password from the endpoint  * Abuse of privileged GlobalProtect components  * Multiple proof-of-concept exploits have now been publicly released  According to the researcher, four PoCs are currently public.  The fifth will remain private until Palo Alto Networks fixes the underlying vulnerability.  But the research raises another interesting issue: vulnerability disclosure itself.  The researcher says the process involved more than 40 emails, multiple disclosure deadlines and months of communication with Palo Alto Networks' PSIRT.  His conclusion:  AI is making vulnerability discovery increasingly accessible — but AI cannot fix a broken vulnerability-disclosure process.  ⚠️ Analyst Note:  There are two separate security lessons here.  First, vulnerabilities in enterprise VPN and endpoint-security software deserve particular attention because these products operate with significant privileges and often sit directly within corporate identity and access infrastructure.  Second, as AI dramatically accelerates vulnerability discovery, vendors may soon face a disclosure-volume problem.  Finding vulnerabilities is becoming faster.  Validating, prioritizing, patching and responsibly coordinating their disclosure still requires humans, mature processes and accountability.  Original Research: globalunprotect.io/  Original Researcher Post: linkedin.com/posts/martijn-v… #DDW #PaloAltoNetworks #GlobalProtect #Vulnerability #CyberSecurity #BugBounty #ThreatResearch

🚨 Alleged WordPress Plugin 0-Day Exploit Offered for Sale  A threat actor on a cybercrime forum is advertising what they claim is source code for a previously undisclosed vulnerability affecting a WordPress plugin with more than 30,000 installations.  * The seller claims the vulnerability allows an attacker to abuse vulnerable WordPress sites to send emails without authentication  * According to the advertisement, the exploit supports both individual and bulk email delivery  * The attacker specifically markets the capability for spam and phishing campaigns sent from legitimate compromised domains  * The exploit allegedly allows customization of sender name, subject and message content  * The seller claims the vulnerability was personally discovered, remains unpatched and is different from another exploit they previously sold  * Asking price: $400  ⚠️ Analyst Note:  The identity of the affected WordPress plugin is not disclosed in the visible advertisement, and the zero-day claim remains unverified.  If authentic, unauthorized email transmission through legitimate WordPress infrastructure could provide threat actors with a valuable phishing capability by abusing the reputation of otherwise trusted domains.  Defenders should monitor unusual outbound email activity from WordPress infrastructure while additional technical details and the affected plugin are identified.  #DDW #WordPress #ZeroDay #0Day #ThreatIntelligence #Cybersecurity #Phishing

🚨 Iran-Linked Hackers Reportedly Shut Down UK Power Generator for Four Days  A cyberattack reportedly forced a small UK electricity generator offline for four days in July 2026, prompting the British government to brief energy-sector executives about the incident.  * The affected facility has not been publicly identified  * Reporting indicates it was a relatively small gas-fired “peaker” plant of roughly 15 MW  * The UK government says the incident posed no risk to the wider British electricity system  * The attack has been attributed in media reporting to hackers linked to Iran  * However, the Iranian attribution has NOT been officially confirmed publicly  ⚠️ Analyst Note:  The significance here is not the amount of electricity lost—it is the demonstrated ability of a cyber operation to disrupt physical energy generation.  Even a relatively small incident provides valuable intelligence about adversary access, operational technology exposure, and potential attack paths that could be applied against larger critical infrastructure targets.  Attribution should currently be treated as reported rather than confirmed.  Sources: telegraph.co.uk/news/2026/08… #DDW #CyberSecurity #CyberAttack #Iran #UK #ThreatIntelligence

🇮🇹 Italian Religious Organization Allegedly Breached — Admin Credentials Claimed Compromised  A threat actor on a cybercrime forum claims to have breached istituti-religiosi.org and released the allegedly stolen data for free.  * The actor claims the compromised information includes usernames, hashed passwords, email addresses, phone numbers, names, dates of birth, transaction IDs and user IDs  * More concerningly, the attacker claims to have identified the organization's phpMyAdmin login interface and obtained credentials for two administrator accounts  * The actor states that brute-force activity was involved in obtaining the alleged administrative access  * The compromised material is reportedly being distributed for free rather than sold  * The screenshot does not establish the volume of affected records or demonstrate that the claimed administrator credentials remain valid  ⚠️ Analyst Note:  This should currently be treated as an unverified breach claim. However, alleged exposure of both user data and administrative credentials materially increases the potential impact.  If the administrative-access claim is authentic, the incident may extend beyond simple database disclosure and could indicate continuing unauthorized access. Immediate credential rotation, authentication-log review, phpMyAdmin exposure assessment and investigation for persistence would be warranted.  #DDW #Italy #DarkWeb #DataBreach #ThreatIntelligence #Cybersecurity

🚨 Fortinet Issues Outbreak Alert: QuickFox Supply Chain Attack  FortiRecon has published a new outbreak alert concerning the QuickFox supply-chain attack and threat activity associated with Twill Typhoon.  According to Fortinet's intelligence, the actor has a significant history of exploiting vulnerabilities across Windows, Microsoft Exchange, Office, Chromium and WinRAR.  * Fortinet identifies the adversary as Twill Typhoon  * The actor has targeted organizations across Asia, Africa, Europe, North America, South America and Oceania  * Targeted sectors span government, technology, media, civil society, defense, critical infrastructure, telecommunications, energy, finance, manufacturing, healthcare, transportation and others  Fortinet highlights seven exploited vulnerabilities associated with the actor:  * CVE-2025-9491 — Microsoft Windows LNK File UI Misrepresentation RCE  * CVE-2025-8088 — WinRAR Path Traversal  * CVE-2024-5274 — Chromium V8 Type Confusion  * CVE-2021-40444 — Microsoft MSHTML RCE  * CVE-2021-27065 — Microsoft Exchange Server RCE  * CVE-2021-26855 — Microsoft Exchange Server RCE  * CVE-2018-0798 — Microsoft Office Memory Corruption  Several are already included in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.  One particularly significant entry is CVE-2025-8088.  * FortiRecon Severity: CRITICAL  * FortiRecon Score: 95/100  * EPSS: 0.94551  * Confirmed exploited  * Associated with ransomware and multiple APT groups  * Included in CISA KEV  * 31 public PoC exploits tracked by FortiRecon  ⚠️ Analyst Note:  Supply-chain attacks can fundamentally change the economics of intrusion.  Rather than compromising organizations individually, attackers can abuse trusted software or distribution channels to create access across many downstream environments.  Fortinet's alert also highlights another important point: sophisticated operations frequently combine newly discovered weaknesses with vulnerabilities that defenders have known about for years.  The vulnerability may be old.  The exploitation isn't necessarily over.  Official Source: Fortinet / FortiRecon community.fortinet.com/forti… #DDW #QuickFox #SupplyChain #TwillTyphoon #CyberSecurity #ThreatIntelligence

🇧🇪 10M Belgian Consumer Records Allegedly Offered for Sale  A threat actor on a cybercrime forum is advertising a dataset allegedly containing information on approximately 10 million Belgian consumers.  * The seller describes the dataset as "Belgium Shopping Consumer Data"  * Approximately 10 million records are claimed to be available  * Advertised fields include email addresses, gender, first and last names, physical addresses, cities, ZIP codes, phone numbers and dates of birth  * The forum post includes a sample containing what appears to be Belgian consumer information  * The seller is offering additional sample data upon request and provides a Telegram contact for prospective buyers  * No specific breached retailer, e-commerce platform or original source of the dataset is identified in the post  ⚠️ Analyst Note:  The 10M-record figure and provenance of the database remain unverified. Without identification of the original source, the dataset could represent a new compromise, aggregated information from multiple sources, or previously exposed data being repackaged for sale.  If authentic and current, the combination of contact information, addresses and dates of birth could significantly increase the effectiveness of targeted phishing, social engineering and identity-fraud campaigns against Belgian consumers.  #DDW #Belgium #DarkWeb #DataBreach #ThreatIntelligence #Cybersecurity

🚨 New Threat Actor Alert: UAT-10147  Cisco Talos has disclosed a previously undocumented Chinese-speaking cybercrime group tracked as UAT-10147, active since early 2026 and targeting vulnerable Windows and Linux web servers worldwide.  * UAT-10147 is assessed as a financially motivated intrusion actor  * Targets include government, education, media, technology and gaming organizations  * Observed activity spans countries including Brazil, Bolivia, China, Canada and Vietnam  * Talos recovered a target list containing approximately 170,000 URLs from actor-controlled infrastructure  * The group aggressively exploits known vulnerabilities in internet-facing systems, including Zimbra, Nacos, Telerik UI, AjaxPro and ASP.NET environments  * Tooling includes a newly identified cross-platform implant called SPECTRE, alongside NoodleRAT, QuasarRAT, Gh0stCringe, Meterpreter and other offensive frameworks  * UAT-10147 also appears to integrate agentic AI into real intrusion workflows for reconnaissance, exploit refinement, payload generation, troubleshooting and persistence  ⚠️ Analyst Note:  UAT-10147 is notable because the AI component appears to go beyond simply generating code.  Researchers observed AI-assisted operational workflows that could help attackers test exploits, interpret failures, modify techniques and scale post-compromise activity more efficiently.  The combination of mass targeting, exploitation of known vulnerabilities, cross-platform implants and AI-supported operations makes UAT-10147 a high-priority actor to monitor. 최근 공격자들은 AI를 활용하여 취약점 탐색부터 공격 코드 수정, 침투 성공 여부 확인까지 자동화하는 'Agentic AI' 기반의 공격을 본격화하고 있습니다 ([데일리시큐](https://www.dailysecu.com/news/articleView.html?idxno=208173)). 또한, 신뢰받는 소프트웨어의 업데이트나 드라이버를 악용하여 보안 솔루션을 우회하는 기법이 고도화되고 있으며, ClickFix와 같은 사회공학적 기법을 결합한 Infostealer 유포가 급증하고 있습니다 ([DarkReading](https://www.darkreading.com/data-privacy/wordlistloader-disguises-malware-ordinary-text)). 특히, 공급망 공격 및 CI/CD 파이프라인을 겨냥한 개발 도구 타겟팅이 지속적으로 관찰되고 있습니다 ([Unit42](https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/sdlc-supply-chain/)).

### 2. 주요 위협 행위자 / 캠페인
- **UAT-10147**: AI를 활용해 전 세계 윈도우/리눅스 웹서버를 대규모로 자동 공격하는 중국계 그룹 ([데일리시큐](https://www.dailysecu.com/news/articleView.html?idxno=208173)).
- **PurpleDelta**: AI 생성 페르소나와 맞춤형 ChatGPT 어시스턴트를 사용하여 기업에 침투하는 북한 IT 노동자 클러스터 ([Recorded Future](https://www.recordedfuture.com/research/purpledelta-fraudulent-employment-operations)).
- **CopyCop**: 아르메니아의 서방향 AI 및 인프라 프로젝트를 방해하는 러시아 영향력 네트워크 ([Recorded Future](https://www.recordedfuture.com/blog/copycop-targets-ai-investment)).
- **HoneyMyte**: CoolClient 백도어에 커널 레벨 Windows rootkit을 추가하여 탐지를 회피하는 APT 그룹 ([Securelist](https://securelist.com/honeymyte-coolclient-driver-rootkit/121028/)).
- **Armored Likho**: 기부 캠페인을 사칭하여 Still Toolkit을 유포하고 Telegram 데이터를 탈취하는 스파이 활동 수행 ([Securelist](https://securelist.com/armored-likho-still-toolkit/121033/)).

### 3. 한국 관련 위협
- **경기도교육청**: 2,500여 개 홈페이지 대상 개인정보 필터링 시스템 전면 재구성 ([데일리시큐](https://www.dailysecu.com/news/articleView.html?idxno=208171)).

- **금융권 위협**: 7월 금융권 대상 Phishing 및 Dropper/Downloader 유포 지속 ([AhnLab ASEC](https://asec.ahnlab.com/ko/95108/)).

- **CVE-2026-73570**: Zimbra 협업 제품, 원격 코드 실행 가능, CISA 3일 내 패치 권고 ([DarkReading](https://www.darkreading.com/vulnerabilities-threats/zimbra-flaw-exploitation-shrinking-window-patch)).
- **CVE-2026-69414**: Microsoft Malware Protection Engine, 권한 상승 제로데이 ([Qualys Blog](https://blog.qualys.com/category/product-tech/vulnmgmt-detection-response)).

- **CVE-2026-68820**: Windows, KEV 등재 및 활발히 악용 중 ([Qualys Blog](https://blog.qualys.com/category/product-tech)).

- **CVE**: CVE-2026-73570 ([DarkReading](https://www.darkreading.com/vulnerabilities-threats/zimbra-flaw-exploitation-shrinking-window-patch)), CVE-2026-69414 ([Qualys Blog](https://blog.qualys.com/category/product-tech/vulnmgmt-detection-response)), CVE-2026-68820 ([Qualys Blog](https://blog.qualys.com/category/product-tech))

- **Zimbra 및 Windows 보안 패치**: CVE-2026-73570 및 CVE-2026-68820에 대해 즉시 패치 적용 및 CISA 가이드라인 준수.
